The legend marks high-temperature levels such as 35℃, 37℃, and 40℃; there are large areas of high-temperature shaded regions in southern China, the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, and the southeast, and some areas have darker colors, indicating that local temperatures are higher. Then reason: The question stem limits it to “from the perspective of the urban environment” and asks “which kind of urban effect.” In the urban environment, buildings are dense, there are many hardened surfaces, and there is much heat discharge, which can make urban air temperatures higher than those of surrounding areas. The geographical term corresponding to this warming phenomenon is the urban heat island effect.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中南方大范围35℃以上、局部更高温的预报区域；再读题干关键词“从城市环境角度”“哪一种城市效应”。把持续高温与城市环境导致的增温现象对应到地理术语，即回答“城市热岛效应”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是2013年7月29日中国高温区域预报图，图例标出35℃、37℃、40℃等高温等级；我国南方、长江中下游及东南一带有大范围高温阴影区，部分区域颜色更深，表示局部温度更高。再推理：题干限定“从城市环境角度看”，并询问“哪一种城市效应”。城市环境中建筑密集、硬化地面多、排热多，会使城市气温高于周边地区，这一增温现象对应的地理术语是城市热岛效应。
